scope: All current development priorities 1–5 addressed; scientific gates and conditional methods remain explicit

jobs.title: Completed product validation
jobs.delivered: Rebuild and verify links, context, reports and byte bindings.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: No biological acceptance inferred.

jobs.title: AnnData interchange
jobs.delivered: Sparse selected raw counts, exact IDs, obs/var and status; real round trip.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Dense matrices rejected; declared raw layer required.

jobs.title: Classic Visium interchange
jobs.delivered: 10x v3 HDF5 and integer MTX; headered/legacy positions; one scale conversion.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Visium HD and automatic unit inference remain outside this profile.

jobs.title: SpatialData exchange
jobs.delivered: Named frames, RNA points/table, optional image/regions, portable store hashes.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: IFQuant-profile import, not arbitrary store discovery.

jobs.title: Dependencies, capacity and CI
jobs.delivered: Locked optional environments, sparse/size guards and Linux/Windows CI.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Full optional stack uses x64 on this ARM64 host; one benchmark is not universal capacity evidence.

jobs.title: OME-NGFF / MCMICRO intake
jobs.delivered: Calibrated bounded NGFF 0.4 YX/CYX window bridge; explicit numeric cell-feature mapping.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: General multidimensional/version-discovery reader deferred; full high-resolution execution continues through tiled TIFF. Avoid ambiguous axis/coordinate inference.

jobs.title: Lung resource audit
jobs.delivered: Kasmani GSM6108348 selected; deposited derivative, identity limits and matrix scope recorded.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Accession proxy is not an independent mouse identity.

jobs.title: Pinned acquisition
jobs.delivered: Four public files verified; compressed and decoded cache drift rejected.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: No source images/counts committed.

jobs.title: Image correspondence
jobs.delivered: Deposited scale and in_tissue flags, real H&E overlay, all 4,992 positions retained.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Visual correspondence only; no physical calibration or independent registration landmarks.

jobs.title: Counts and round trips
jobs.delivered: 2,486 measured and 2,506 not reported; five source gene totals reconciled and both native round trips passed.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Five-gene panel is an interchange test, not biological domain evidence.

jobs.title: Reusable lung replay
jobs.delivered: Fresh-output command, pinned inputs, HTML/overlay, memory and timing record.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Source paper biological comparisons not reproduced.

jobs.title: Real high-resolution qualification
jobs.delivered: 46,000 x 32,914 Aperio source; 64 reproducible reads; fixed base-pyramid reader bug.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Single-source read benchmark, not complete slide-analysis throughput or lung accuracy.

jobs.title: Annotation and sampling protocol
jobs.delivered: Anatomy, lesion, artifact, uncertainty, exhaustive-negative coverage and biological-unit protocol.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Acquisition-specific independent expert annotations still needed.

jobs.title: Appearance / QuPath classifier comparison
jobs.delivered: Existing frozen appearance baseline plus discrete-label QuPath bridge and mask metrics; real runtime threshold-fixture pass.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Supervised pathology model and held-out reference comparison still required.

jobs.title: Native / StarDist qualification
jobs.delivered: Previously repaired geometry export, frozen warning evidence and independent object-evaluation framework retained.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: 1,322 accepted StarDist topology warnings still need boundary review; no scientific equivalence claim.

jobs.title: InstanSeg executor / comparison
jobs.delivered: Common label comparison boundary and model identity requirements specified.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Canonical InstanSeg executor not implemented. Activate after suitable image/reference/weight terms and a declared comparison question; avoid another unscored backend.

jobs.title: Morphology endpoints
jobs.delivered: Qualified area endpoints; calibrated cuff area per inner perimeter and reviewed septal transects.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Replaced unsupported automatic thickness/stereology interpretation with explicit 2D profile measurements.

jobs.title: Severity / reviewer agreement
jobs.delivered: Versioned ordinal forms retained; paired agreement, weighted kappa and missingness added.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Model-specific rubric and real blinded reviewers still needed; no universal score.

jobs.title: Gene/program registry
jobs.delivered: Versioned species/exact-ID registry, source reference and coverage thresholds.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Only synthetic example program shipped. Niethamer-derived biological programs require source-table curation and intended-use justification.

jobs.title: RNA filtering / normalization
jobs.delivered: Sparse raw data retained; explicit panel or external full-library denominator, log1p(CP10k), coverage/filter abstention.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Simple measured-RNA summary, not lineage or deconvolution.

jobs.title: Spatial graph and null baseline
jobs.delivered: Bounded radius graph, explicit units/window, region/coverage-conditioned permutations and effect reports.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Conditional within-specimen inference only.

jobs.title: Reference mapping / cell2location / Tangram
jobs.delivered: Input, leakage and baseline activation gates specified.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: No compatible independent reference selected; engines not installed/executed. A small panel cannot justify deconvolution.

jobs.title: Domain baseline / BANKSY comparison
jobs.delivered: Seeded expression-only and graph-smoothed clustering with explicit eligibility and limits.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Real broad-feature lung replay and BANKSY comparison remain conditional; cluster smoothness is not accuracy.

jobs.title: Morphology–RNA association
jobs.delivered: Within-stratum biological-unit aggregation, rank effect, permutation and BH; repeated-group designs rejected.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Requires matched endpoints and verified independent biological units; current source replay does not provide those.

jobs.title: VALIS result adapter
jobs.delivered: Live Slide forward-point exporter with explicit level-zero direction and portable CSV.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: API boundary tested with fixture; actual paired-slide VALIS registration still unexecuted.

jobs.title: Registration qualification
jobs.delivered: Separate fit/evaluation errors, sampled folds/area change and local held-out support.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Independent real landmarks and representative local deformation coverage required.

jobs.title: Processed Slide-GoTags intake
jobs.delivered: MC38-OVA author-column profile, exact IDs, observed coverage, expression/nanopore distinction and clonotype missingness.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Synthetic source-profile fixture only; processed cell download requires portal sign-in. Coverage-free author calls are not promoted.

jobs.title: Frozen spatial hypotheses
jobs.delivered: Hashes, pairs, radii, units, seed, coverage strata, boundary policy and sensitivity are explicit inputs.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: No post-hoc biological hypothesis supplied by the tool.

jobs.title: Nulls / multiplicity / uncertainty
jobs.delivered: Finite-sample corrected conditioned permutations, undefined/degenerate abstention, BH and jitter ranges.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Revision of author global shuffle/zero substitution; jitter range is not a confidence interval.

jobs.title: Narrow source reproduction
jobs.delivered: 240 RCC_1_A reported-statistic rows / six pairs match across supplement and figure source.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: Full cell-level NMS/p-value reproduction remains gated by authenticated processed data; source tables lack coordinates/edge counts.

jobs.title: LIANA+ / SpatialGlue / CODEX extensions
jobs.delivered: Activation criteria and comparative evidence requirements retained in methodology roadmap.
jobs.remaining_or_rationale: No paired compatible assays/question/reference that justify these engines yet; not installed or claimed implemented.
